entities.name: Duke Ferdinand of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duke Ferdinand of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel was a German military officer best known for his participation in the Seven Years' War. From 1757 to 1762, he led an Anglo-German army in western Germany which successfully repelled French attempts to capture Hanover.
